mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a people's dominant orientation towards politics."
Political culture refers to a people's dominant orientation towards politics.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the processes and ways in which political values, beliefs and orientations are handed down from one generation to the other through structures and institutions that are called agents of socialization."

Political socialization refers to the processes and ways in which political values, beliefs and orientations are handed down from one generation to the other through structures and institutions that are called agents of socialization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an organized body of people who participate in political activities with the sole aim of getting political power."
A political party is an organized body of people who participate in political activities with the sole aim of getting political power.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major way of political participation."
Election is a major way of political participation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means by which representatives are chosen to perform specified tasks by, and on behalf of a wider body of persons has some functions in the political society of man."
Elections as a means by which representatives are chosen to perform specified tasks by, and on behalf of a wider body of persons has some functions in the political society of man.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very vital aspect of the workings of a political system. (d) InterestAggregation As political interests and preferences differ in politics, elections help to aggregate them in political communities."

Interest articulation is a very vital aspect of the workings of a political system. (d) InterestAggregation As political interests and preferences differ in politics, elections help to aggregate them in political communities.

The family for instance is the first agent of political socialization that a child is exposed to at a tender age when his or her personality is still being formed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the field that encompasses the whole."
Collective action is the field that encompasses the whole.

Judgmental heuristics are used to solve "Simon's puzzle" of how to decide rationally "with limited information and processing capacity".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the way people think, feel, and act with regard to politics."
Political behaviour is the study of the way people think, feel, and act with regard to politics.
